name: Achan
summary: A man of Judah who secretly took things the LORD had forbidden, bringing defeat on Israel. When he was found out, Israel stoned him in the valley of Achor.

key_moments.title: Takes the Accursed Thing
key_moments.description: Achan took some of what had been set apart for the LORD, and the LORD was angry with Israel. When Israel attacked the small town of Ai, they were beaten and fled.

key_moments.title: Found Out
key_moments.description: Joshua brought the tribes, families and households forward until Achan was taken. Achan confessed that he had coveted a fine robe, silver and gold, and buried them in his tent.

key_moments.title: Stoned in the Valley of Achor
key_moments.description: Joshua and all Israel took Achan, his family and everything he had to the valley of Achor, where Israel stoned him. Then the LORD turned from His fierce anger.
